technical.summary: Early momentum signals (MACD/PPO crossovers, StochRSI cross-up) conflict with weak price structure below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud; low volume ratio and neutral sector headwind reduce conviction.

fundamental.summary: KHC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 36 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (392.0), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 36 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO crossovers and Supertrend bullish signals with extreme fear sentiment (13/100) offer contrarian entry opportunity near support at 28.96.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages (EMA/SMA 21 and 50), Ichimoku cloud, weak volume, VIX crisis, unfavorable macro, and high earnings risk within 36 days create compounding headwinds that outweigh early momentum signals.
